old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jqvl","title":"Rust SCHC authenticated-DIO capability issuance omits local destination binding","description":"Security review P2. PeerContextAuthority::issue_from_authenticated_dio and AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext::from_authenticated_dio_frame in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs validate current link evidence, signer/source, checksum, DIO scope/role, and version, but never require the authenticated L2 destination to be this receiver nor validate the IPv6 destination as allowed local/multicast. These public capability constructors can therefore elevate a valid signed DIO addressed to a different node when used outside the node wrapper, and downstream fragmentation policy trusts the issued capability.
